## Agarican, Aserubera (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
LN Medium plant (fungus)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +25  
**Aura** stench (DC 25, 15 rounds)  


**Defense**


**AC** 27, touch 17, flat-footed 20 (+6 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural)  
**hp** 221 (17d8+85)  
**Fort** +15, **Ref** +11, **Will** +11  
**Immune** plant traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 1 slam +16 (1d6+3), 6 tentacles +15 (1d6+3 plus poison)  
**Spell-like Abilities** (CL 12th; concentration +17)  


Constant—speak with plants  

At will—dancing lights, plant shape II  

3/day—plant growth  

1/day—transport via plants  



**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 22, **Con** 20, **Int** 19, **Wis** 23, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +18, **CMD** 34  
**Feats** Cleave, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, Great Cleave, Greater Trip, Improved Critical (tentacles), Improved Stench, Improved Trip, [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam).*  
**Skills** Bluff +19, Intimidate +19, Knowledge (nature) +21, Perception +25, Sense Motive +22, Stealth +22  
**Languages** Agaric, Common, Sylvan, Terran, Undercommon; limited telepathy 100 ft.  


**Special Abilities**


**Luminescent Lamella (Ex)** The arms of an aserubra’s cap glow with a soft light, fading to darkness towards the tips. This emits light as a candle, increasing to that of a torch when the aserubra is using any of its spell-like abilities.  

**Mutamorph (Ex)** Despite being a plant, an aserubra can be affected by polymorph effects.  

**Poison (Ex)** Slam—injury; *save* Fort DC 27; *frequency* 1/round for 4 rounds; *effect* 1d3 Int; *cure* 1 save. Save DC is Con-based.  

**Spore Savant (Ex)** An aserubra who has allowed themselves to be infected by a psibyl’s psychic spores may expend a daily use of their plant growth ability while the psibyl is using its witness power on them to cause the psychic spores to not be destroyed at the end of the ability. As a standard action, an aserubra may cast sending, targeting any creature within 1 mile infected with psychic spores from the same psibyl, though the infected creature may choose to make a new saving throw against the psychic spores instead of responding to the sending. The psibyl whose spores infect the aserubra and its contact is aware of the content of messages sent through the sending effect, and also has the option to restrict who an aserubra is able to contact with this ability to as many or few individuals as they choose.  


**About**


**Environment** temperate forests or swamps  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or band (1-3 and 3 times that number unintelligent plant creatures)  
**Treasure** standard
